chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Hamza Abu Ya'la, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Abi Khalid, who elevated it (as a mursal), from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him):
'When the new moon of the month of Rajab is confirmed, count fifty-nine days and fast on the sixtieth day.'

key_terms.رَجَب: Rajab — the seventh month of the Islamic lunar calendar, one of the four sacred months
key_terms.رَفَعَهُ: Rafa'ahu — a technical term indicating that the narrator omitted one or more intermediate transmitters and attributed the hadith directly to an Imam or the Prophet; renders the isnad mursal (broken)
key_terms.صَحَّ: Holds good / is confirmed — here meaning that the sighting of the crescent has been verified and the new month has been established
key_terms.هِلَال: Hilal — the crescent moon as it appears at the beginning of a lunar month; its sighting is the traditional Islamic method for determining the start of months

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq say about fasting and counting days from the crescent of Rajab?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a ruling attributed to Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) regarding the determination of the fast at the end of the month of Sha'ban (i.e., the first day of Ramadan) by reference to the sighting of the Rajab crescent. The method of counting fifty-nine days from the confirmed sighting of the Rajab new moon provides a reliable calculation for the beginning of Ramadan when direct sighting may be difficult. This represents the Imam's jurisprudential guidance on lunar calendar reckoning in classical Shia fiqh.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Hamza Abu Ya’la, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan Bin Abu Khalid, raising it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>:
‘When the new moon of the month of Rajab holds good, so count fifty nine days and Fast on the sixtieth (day)’.
en.sarwar: 8. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Hamzah ibn abu Ya‘liy from Muhammad ibn al- Hassan ibn abu Khalid in a marfu‘ manner who has said the following: “He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If the crescent of the month of Rajab is established, then count fifty nine days and fast the sixtieth day.’”
